divergences.subject: GetAddressFromPointer result width
divergences.decision: Keep the slot opaque (void*); no callable signature before a per-profile qualification.

divergences.subject: previousOpcode and nextOpcode result width
divergences.hostPascal: ce_previousOpcode and ce_nextOpcode return ptrUint (pluginexports.pas lines 28-29)
divergences.decision: Never generate a 32-bit result from the header; slots stay unexposed.

divergences.subject: disassembleEx address parameter
divergences.headerC: CEP_DISASSEMBLEEX takes the address by value
divergences.hostPascal: the slot is assigned ce_disassemble, which takes a pointer to the address (pluginexports.pas line 27)
divergences.decision: Review the effective slot binding before any native projection; slot stays unexposed.

divergences.subject: createForm parameter list
divergences.decision: Use the documented Lua route (createForm); never declare the two ABI forms equivalent.

divergences.subject: image_transparent and image_stretch boolean width
divergences.headerC: the flag parameter is a four-byte BOOL
divergences.hostPascal: the flag parameter is a one-byte Pascal boolean (pluginexports.pas lines 88-89)
divergences.decision: Make the boolean width explicit before any projection; slots stay unexposed.

divergences.subject: classic GetLuaState calling convention
divergences.hostPascal: the slot is assigned plugin_getluastate, declared stdcall (pluginexports.pas line 131)
divergences.decision: Never transpose this convention to the distinct 48-byte managed table, whose GetLuaState stays stdcall.

divergences.subject: process watcher callback (plugin type 3)
divergences.headerC: CEP_PLUGINTYPE3 returns void and takes a 32-bit peprocess
divergences.hostPascal: TPluginFunction3 returns integer and takes a pointer-sized peprocess (plugin.pas line 776); version-1 plugins get a two-argument call
divergences.decision: ProcessWatcherPluginInit.Callback stays opaque (void*) until a profile decision.

divergences.subject: pointer-change callback result (plugin type 4)
divergences.hostPascal: TPluginFunction4 returns a Pascal boolean (plugin.pas line 787)
divergences.decision: Determine the effective use of the result; the callback stays opaque, no silent removal.

divergences.subject: type-0 selection record
divergences.headerC: PLUGINTYPE0_RECORD: UINT_PTR address, BOOL ispointer (agrees with the host)
divergences.hostPascal: host TPlugin0_SelectedRecord (plugin.pas lines 726-735): ptrUint address, BOOL ispointer; kit mirrors in cepluginsdk.pas use dword address (lines 161-170) or boolean ispointer (lines 147-156)
divergences.decision: Offsets and widths follow the host type; SelectedRecordOracleTests keep both mirrors as negative oracles.

divergences.subject: managed bootstrap entry signature
divergences.headerC: not declared in the C kit; the historical public C# example uses a string entry
divergences.hostPascal: the SDK targets the hostfxr component form (IntPtr args, int size) with the 36-byte packed TPluginDotNetInitResult (plugin.pas lines 29-36)
divergences.decision: Separate load profiles; never fix the SDK from the historical example.

divergences.subject: KernelVirtualAllocEx assignment target
divergences.headerC: the slot is named KernelVirtualAllocEx in all three declarations
divergences.hostPascal: the assignment expression is @VQE, a name that does not match the field and is not declared in pluginexports.pas
divergences.decision: Record the expression verbatim (ToQualify); invent no semantics and expose nothing.

divergences.subject: indirection inside the cell section (slots 18-81)
divergences.headerC: both mirrors declare the whole section as pointer cells (cepluginsdk.pas ppointer; cepluginsdk.h groups it as cells)
divergences.hostPascal: the host assigns a cell address (@@) only to some slots of the section; the listed slots receive a direct @ expression
divergences.decision: Classify each slot from its host assignment, never from the section; the listed slots are not cells.
divergences.auditRef: S-ABI source observation; annexes/04 minimum access size and indirection
